definition.title: See what the last email campaign taught you
definition.description: Compare a finished campaign's delivery ledger against its shortlist and get per-segment reply and bounce rates, the subject that earned replies, and named next actions.

ledger_csv.title: Delivery ledger (CSV)
ledger_csv.description: A row per touch with columns recipient, segment, subject, touch, status, replied_at. Copy it from the campaign's delivery ledger in project Files.

shortlist_csv.title: Shortlist (CSV)
shortlist_csv.description: The campaign's shortlist export, with at least the columns email and segment.
